rows.name: Whitby Harbour
rows.character: One green tide light One red or green light
rows.description: Green tide light on W. pier, from 2 hours' flood to 2 hours' ebb. E. Pier lt. red to S., but green to N. of Rock buoy

rows.name: Coatham
rows.description: Red light on outer end of pier

rows.name: Bran Sand
rows.description: Wooden towers. (Not used)

rows.character: 1. Fifth buoy, br. fix. lt. 2. Seal Sand, red fix. lt.
rows.description: 1. and 2. 1,200 yds. apart; in one, S.W. ¼ W., mark for Fairway buoy, and lead in. There are six small lts. up the Tees

rows.name: Seaton
rows.description: In one, N.W. by W. (118 yards apart)

rows.name: HARTLEPOOL
rows.character: High bright, low red tide light
rows.description: On the Heugh. The red tide lt., or red ball, from half flood to half ebb

rows.name: Hartlepool Old Harbour
rows.description: Red lt. on pier; two red lts. on quay

rows.name: „ West Harbour
rows.description: Green lt. on N. Pier; two red lts. in one lead in while 10 ft. water

rows.name: Seaham
rows.character: Upper bright fixed lt., low red rev. lt. ½ min.
rows.description: In one stone tower, 58 ft. high, on Red Acre Point

rows.name: Seaham Harbour
rows.description: Red tide light, when practicable

rows.name: Sunderland
rows.character: Upper bright, lower red lt. on N. pier, one br. tide light on S. pier
rows.description: N. pier lts. all night. Tide lt. on S. pier, from ½ flood to ½ ebb; a green lt. below it shows danger

rows.name: SOUTER POINT
rows.character: One brilliant rev. lt. ½ min.; lower bright or red light
rows.description: Tower, 76 ft. "Magneto-Electric" lts. Lower br. lt. from S. by E. to S. ½ W.; thence red to S. by W. ¾ W over Whitburn Stile, Hendon Rocks, &c. Powerful fog-horn ev. ½ min.

rows.name: TYNEMOUTH
rows.description: White tower, 79 ft. high. Near Priory ruins, in the castle

rows.name: Tyne North Pier
rows.description: Vertical, on North Pier Works. A red lt. at middle of North pier

rows.name: Tyne River
rows.description: At North Shields; in one, W. by N., 240 yards apart; shown all night

rows.name: Blyth
rows.description: While 8 ft. water; in one, N. by W. ¾ W.

rows.name: COQUET ISLAND
rows.character: Two fixed lights in one tower
rows.description: Upper lt. br. seaward, but red W. of N. by E. ½ E., over Bulmer Bush Rocks, &c. Lower lt. br. from S.S.E. to S. ½ E.; thence westward is red over Bondicar Bush, to S. by W. ½ W.

rows.name: Warkworth, red Tide Light
rows.description: While 10 ft. water. On South pier

rows.name: FARN ISLAND
rows.character: Upper light rev. ½ min., lower fixed light
rows.description: Two white towers, 43 and 27 ft.; in one, N. by W. ½ W., 167 yards apart; high light near S.W. point

rows.name: LONGSTONE
rows.character: One br. rev. lt. ½ min.
rows.description: Red tower on W. side of rock. Dangers extend ¾ mile to N.E. Fog Horn, 2 blasts ev. 2 min.

rows.name: Berwick-on-Tweed
rows.description: Tower, 44 ft., on the pier-head. Lights not visible W. of Seal Carr Ledges. Low red lt., while 10 ft., on bar
